thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: p95 latency breach detected for /chat.generate in prod-us-east-2 at 1902468101 (p95 1.8s > SLO). Smart-routing made multiple fallback decisions.

Renee M.: i'm on it. initial glance shows repeated fallback toggles between variant 'full' and 'quant-lite' plus occasional region spill to us-east-1.

Diego V.: dumping routing decision stream:```
1902468098 DECIDE: region=us-east-2 model=full -> serve
1902468101 METRIC p95=1.82s -> fallback to model=quant-lite
1902468104 METRIC p95=0.90s -> route to model=full
1902468106 METRIC p95=1.70s -> fallback quant-lite
1902468110 DECIDE: cross-region fallback to us-east-1
1902468113 DECIDE: back to us-east-2
```

Hannah O.: that back-and-forth pattern is ~2-6s. looks like the policy evaluates short-window p95 and immediately flips. no hysteresis or cooldown was applied.

platform-oncall: infra check: no host down, autoscaler healthy. recorded a transient network blip at 1902468109 for 12s but TCP retries recovered.

Renee M.: CS-notify, any customer reports?

CS-notify: three tenants reported slower response times; one flagged as high-priority (enterprise). open channel with account team.

Diego V.: mitigation options: A) disable auto-fallback entirely B) add a swap cooldown C) increase evaluation window to smooth p95 D) pin enterprise tenant to model=full in-region.

Hannah O.: i'd do B+C+D quick. disabling fallback removes safety valve. slower but safer: add 45s cooldown and change evaluation to 60s-window median/p95 blend.

Renee M.: applying temporary policy changes: PATCH routing-service -> {"variant_swap_cooldown_secs":45,"metric_window_secs":60} -> applied at 1902468135.

deploy-bot: policy-manager deploy started (commit 7c9d0f) at 1902468138, finished 1902468148.

platform-oncall: after deploy, swap events dropped to 0 and p95 returned to 780ms within ~3m. region spill stopped.

CS-notify: enterprise tenant notified: "We observed transient latency during a routing loop; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a post-incident report."

Renee M.: root cause hypothesis: a recent config change in fallback_policy removed the cooldown and set metric_window_secs down to 10s (PR #4992). That made the controller react to short transients.

Diego V.: searching PR history... found PR #4992 merged 2h ago by automation that applied cost-optimization flags and unintentionally set metric_window_secs=10 and removed cooldown.

Hannah O.: revert plan: revert PR #4992, re-introduce 60s default cooldown, add merge gate for policy JSON changes.

Renee M.: executing revert now. git revert 4992 && deploy policy-manager -> initiated at 1902468200.

deploy-bot: revert deploy finished at 1902468244. policy-manager version rolled back to stable. verified defaults: swap_cooldown=60, metric_window_secs=60.

platform-oncall: monitoring after revert: p95 stable, no swap events, region fallback inactive.

Diego V.: follow-up action items being created: - enforce default values in schema (cooldown >=30s) - add integration test simulating noisy p95 - add alert for swap_rate > 3/min - require two approvals for routing policy changes - pin enterprise tenants by default during policy changes

Renee M.: creating ticket RED-7205 with owners Diego (policy), Hannah (ops), Renee (customer comms).

CS-notify: account team requested logs and a short timeline for the enterprise tenant; provided provisional timeline and promised a detailed postmortem with remediation.

platform-oncall: note: network blip overlap investigated; NOC traced to an upstream provider and not the primary cause. logged as contributing factor but not root.

Hannah O.: watching for 30m. will handoff to platform-oncall for overnight after that. please add monitoring links to RED-7205.

incident-bot: Incident PD ticket PD-7589 created and annotated. mitigation: cooldown reinstated, metric window increased, revert applied.

Renee M.: thanks all. good quick work. i'll compile notes for the blameless postmortem and coordinate with CS for the customer write-up.

Diego V.: added timeline and routing-audit snippet to RED-7205. Estimated customer-impact window: 1902468101 - 1902468250.

platform-oncall: no further anomalies. handing back to Renee for final sign-off after watch period.

CS-notify: enterprise tenant acknowledged. awaiting postmortem.
